subject.title: fix(hooks): serialize same-session agent hook dispatch to prevent silent event loss from session-claim races

question: Which open implementation should be the canonical fix for the same-session hook claim race: this proof-backed PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110134?
rationale: Both branches address the same canonical issue but differ in test shape, scope, proof state, and current-base freshness; selecting one landing candidate is an ownership decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
options.body: Prefer this smaller implementation because it includes after-fix production-path terminal evidence and focused regression coverage; close or redirect the overlapping branch after the selection.

options.title: Adopt the competing PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110134 only after it receives equivalent real behavior proof and is refreshed against current main.

options.title: Request a consolidated replacement
options.body: Pause both branches only if gateway owners want a different queue abstraction or broader operational semantics than either current implementation provides.

recommendation.body: Prefer this smaller implementation because it includes after-fix production-path terminal evidence and focused regression coverage; close or redirect the overlapping branch after the selection.
